scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:45373/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.headline: Finding which recall explanation the lab evidence supports
args.objective: Read the recall brief at 127.0.0.1:45373/recall-brief, follow each of the three explanation dossiers and their linked independent lab reports, and determine which explanation the lab evidence supports (with the key measurement) and why the other two are ruled out.

args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.
args.observation: The independent lab found bearing seats on every recalled Q3 widget batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize; the bearing seat machining theory is SUPPORTED.

args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.
args.observation: The independent lab found coating cure times within tolerance on every recalled batch; the ceramic coating cure theory is NOT supported.

args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.
args.observation: The independent lab found packaging matched spec on every recalled batch; the packaging compression theory is NOT supported.

metrics.answerText:
**Q3 fixture widget recall — lab verdict**

**Supported: bearing seat machining.** The independent lab measured the bearing seats on every recalled batch and found them **machined 0.4 mm undersize** — that measurement is what the verdict rests on.

**Ruled out: ceramic coating cure.** Lab report: "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."

**Ruled out: packaging compression.** Lab report: "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."

Sources read: [recall brief](http://127.0.0.1:45373/recall-brief) → [coating dossier](http://127.0.0.1:45373/theory-coating) / [bearing dossier](http://127.0.0.1:45373/theory-bearing) / [packaging dossier](http://127.0.0.1:45373/theory-packaging), and lab reports for [coating](http://127.0.0.2:32993/lab-coating), [bearing](http://127.0.0.2:32993/lab-bearing), and [packaging](http://127.0.0.2:32993/lab-packaging). Each dossier itself states no verdict; the verdicts above come solely from the linked independent lab reports.

scenarios.command: three consignments are listed at http://127.0.0.1:45373/consignment-index. each one's custody record is a chain of eight legs, and every leg links only the next one, so the seal number is on the last leg of each chain. for all three consignments, follow the whole chain and tell me the port it departed from and its container seal number

args.headline: Trace 3 consignment chains to find departure ports and seal numbers
args.objective: Follow each consignment's 8-leg custody chain from the consignment index to its final leg, and report the departure port and container seal number for all three consignments.

args.escalation_reason: The consignment index shows three independent 8-leg custody chains across two servers; 16 further sequential page reads (Marlin and Ibex chains) remain, exceeding the Lookup budget.
args.headline: Trace consignment chains: Falcon done, Marlin & Ibex in parallel
args.objective: Follow each consignment's 8-leg custody chain from the consignment index to its final leg, and report the departure port and container seal number for all three consignments (Falcon, Marlin, Ibex).

args.task: Follow the custody chain for Consignment Marlin and report two facts. Start at http://127.0.0.1:45373/consign-marlin — this is leg 1 of 8 and states the port the consignment departed from; note that port. Each page links only the next leg; follow the links leg by leg until you reach leg 8 of 8, which carries the container seal number. Do not guess URLs — only use the link href shown on each page. Report: (1) the departure port from leg 1, (2) the container seal number from leg 8, with (3) the URLs of leg 1 and leg 8 as evidence.

Follow the custody chain for Consignment Ibex and report two facts. Start at http://127.0.0.1:45373/consign-ibex — this is leg 1 of 8 and states the port the consignment departed from; note that port. Each page links only the next leg; follow the links leg by leg until you reach leg 8 of 8, which carries the container seal number. Do not guess URLs — only use the link href shown on each page. Report: (1) the departure port from leg 1, (2) the container seal number from leg 8, with (3) the URLs of leg 1 and leg 8 as evidence.

args.excerpt:
Consignment Falcon: leg 1 of 8
Consignment Falcon departed Valdez on the first leg of its custody chain.
args.observation: Consignment Falcon departed from the port of Valdez, stated on leg 1 of its custody chain.

args.excerpt: Consignment Falcon arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-8123. This is the end of the chain.
args.observation: Consignment Falcon's container seal number is SEAL-8123, carried on leg 8 (final leg) of its custody chain.

args.excerpt: Consignment Marlin departed Ostend on the first leg of its custody chain.
args.observation: Consignment Marlin departed from the port of Ostend, stated on leg 1 of its custody chain.

args.excerpt: Consignment Marlin arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-4470. This is the end of the chain.
args.observation: Consignment Marlin's container seal number is SEAL-4470, carried on leg 8 (final leg) of its custody chain.

args.excerpt: Consignment Ibex departed Trieste on the first leg of its custody chain.
args.observation: Consignment Ibex departed from the port of Trieste, stated on leg 1 of its custody chain.

args.excerpt: Consignment Ibex arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-9056. This is the end of the chain.
args.observation: Consignment Ibex's container seal number is SEAL-9056, carried on leg 8 (final leg) of its custody chain.

metrics.answerText:

| Consignment | Departed from | Container seal |
|---|---|---|
| Falcon | **Valdez** | **SEAL-8123** |
| Marlin | **Ostend** | **SEAL-4470** |
| Ibex | **Trieste** | **SEAL-9056** |

Evidence — leg 1 (departure port) and leg 8 (seal):
- **Falcon**: [leg 1](http://127.0.0.1:45373/consign-falcon) — "departed Valdez"; [leg 8](http://127.0.0.2:32993/custody-c8sy) — "container seal SEAL-8123"

- **Ibex**: [leg 1](http://127.0.0.1:45373/consign-ibex) — "departed Trieste"; [leg 8](http://127.0.0.2:32993/custody-u3pk) — "container seal SEAL-9056"
